visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bustling indoor market stall. A young man wearing a beige tank top and glasses is seen from the chest up, standing behind a counter with a very large, shallow silver metal pot. He holds a large metal ladle, ready to cook. Behind him are several colorful plastic bags hanging and a pink sign for 'Bread' and other market goods. The lighting is bright fluorescent. (2) The camera moves to a top-down close-up of the large pot where onions, dried shrimp, and other aromatics are being sautéed. Shortly after, a yellow plastic basket filled with sliced wood ear mushrooms and carrots is poured over a massive mound of fresh, chopped green and white napa cabbage. (3) The man uses the large ladle to stir the enormous pile of cabbage in the pot. He works diligently in the bright setting. The scene cuts to a view of the finished dish, now cooked down into a savory, yellowish stew, being ladled into a stainless steel container. (4) A close-up shot features a stainless steel tray filled with Shanghai vegetable rice, which includes visible bits of green leafy vegetables and small dried shrimp. A wooden spoon scoops out a portion. Another shot shows a bowl of the same rice being held up, showcasing its fluffy texture. (5) A clear plastic bag containing the stewed cabbage and its golden-brown broth is held up against the market background, steaming slightly. The camera then pans across a counter filled with numerous pre-packaged round plastic bowls containing various cooked dishes, ready for sale. (6) The man is shown again, now focusing on bagging portions of food. The video concludes with a wide shot of the stall, named '大俠手路菜,' with a large white text overlay providing the address and market location details.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道高雄德民市場. [Logo]: @hooleefun. (2) [Subtitle]: 有一間很好吃的手路菜嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 老板每天在市場現炒白菜滷. (4) [Subtitle]: 真的加料加到爆. (5) [Subtitle]: 滿滿的大白菜堆成一座白菜山. (6) [Subtitle]: 下鍋和蝦米香菇紅蘿蔔豆薯. (7) [Subtitle]: 一起慢火滷製. (8) [Subtitle]: 白菜清脆多汁. (9) [Subtitle]: 帶著微甜滋味和蝦米香氣. (10) [Subtitle]: 只有稍微勾芡. (11) [Subtitle]: 吃起來特別涮嘴. (12) [Subtitle]: 再配一碗上海菜飯. (13) [Subtitle]: 融合蝦米香菇的鮮味. (14) [Subtitle]: 還有青江菜的脆爽口感. (15) [Subtitle]: 搭配白菜滷一起吃更對味. (16) [Subtitle]: 這裡每天還有不同的手路菜. (17) [Subtitle]: 像是豉汁排骨就很受歡迎. (18) [Subtitle]: 喜歡白菜滷的快來試試. (2) As the narrator describes the cooking process, the metallic clinking of a large ladle scraping against a metal pot becomes audible. These incidental noises are crisp and rhythmic, blending with the background music. The voice-over remains the dominant signal with high clarity. (3) The narrator continues with high enthusiasm, listing ingredients for the stewed cabbage. Subtle sounds of a plastic bag rustling are heard as food is packaged. The BGM maintains a consistent, joyful mood without any breaks or dramatic shifts in harmonic tension. (4) The recording ends with a clean sign-off from the narrator while the music continues at a steady volume until the final hard cut. The overall mix is well-balanced with professional-grade vocal clarity over the background bed.

It highlights the abundant ingredients and meticulous cooking process of their signature stewed cabbage and Shanghai vegetable rice to attract local food enthusiasts and visitors.
